tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Arlo wants to talk about swimming lesson. which lesson to attend. what towel to bring. when to arrive.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Arlo.

promptBlocks.subject: Swimming plans
paragraphs: I am writing about swimming lesson. which lesson to attend? what towel to bring?
when to arrive? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Arlo and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: swimming lesson
ketImageBrief.panel1: Arlo starts swimming lesson with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Arlo solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
